messages:
Jordan: Quick sync — ACME enterprise pilot needs clarification on the customer-managed key handshake and timeline. They want a 2-week integration window, HSM attestation checks, and rotation under their control. Can we confirm: timeline/ops, whether key material is excluded from Redwood logs, and a rough pricing delta if they require HSM-backed keys vs cloud KMS?

Sam: Got it. I need answers for SOW line items. Do we have a standard 'no key material retained' clause in our template? :thinking:

Priya: Short answers: 1) We support BYOK with HSM attestation. 2) Rotation model — customer-initiated rotations are supported; default blackout/grace window is 72h but configurable. 3) Logs — we store only key IDs and operation metadata, never plaintext key material. We should call out attestation report cadence (monthly/quarterly per contract). :ok_hand:

Alicia: From infra side: integration estimate ~3 dev days for HSM transport + 1 day for infra runbook and test. Network requirements: whitelist Redwood egress to customer gateway (example block below) and enable mutual TLS for key-proxy on 8443. Sample firewall snippet for their ops: 
```
iptables -A OUTPUT -d 10.5.2.0/24 -p tcp --dport 8443 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW -j ACCEPT
```
Also: connector credentials must be customer-provided and stored in Vault; we require a customer token scoped to key operations only.

Jordan: Can you convert those into bullet answers I can paste into the security questionnaire? Also need a rough MRC/OPEX delta for HSM vs KMS to include in the quote.

Sam: Preliminary pricing: HSM-backed BYOK adds approx +$8k/mo (reserved, includes attestation service) + one-time setup $6k. Cloud-KMS BYOK ~ +$2k/mo + setup $1.5k. These are ballpark — will confirm with finance. :moneybag:

Priya: Security bullets you can reuse: 
- "Redwood does not persist plaintext customer key material."
- "Customer keys remain under customer control in their HSM/KMS; Redwood retains only key identifiers and operation metadata (timestamps, operation types)."
- "FIPS 140-2/3 validated HSMs supported; we can include attestation artifacts on request."
- "Rotation policy: customer-initiated; Redwood supports scheduled automated rotations and a configurable grace period during cutover."
Paste for questionnaire: 
```
We do not persist customer key material. Audit logs contain operation IDs and timestamps only; key material is never stored in Redwood systems.
```

Alicia: Ops notes for SOW: include rollback plan — if a customer rotation fails we can fallback to a secondary key version for up to 24h; anything beyond requires an SLA exception. Also need a 2-hour network cutover test window during pilot acceptance; suggested maintenance slot: weekend 02:00-04:00 PST.

Jordan: Great — I'll summarize and send to ACME. Sam, can you get a firm quote by EOD? Priya, can you attach the template clause + a redacted sample attestation report? Alicia, can you prepare the runbook checklist and test window dates?

Sam: On it, confirming with finance and will update by 17:00 PT. :thumbsup:

kms-bot: Deployed key-proxy v1.9 to staging — integration tests passed (3/3).
